name: The Grok Bot Agent Blueprint
description_md:
Stop treating a multi-agent system like one big AI brain
This free companion pack breaks the system into understandable parts: agent identity, isolated transcripts, durable memory, asynchronous direct messages, priority interruption, bounded group meetings, separate desktop screens, scoped permissions, workflows, model adapters, and the scheduler underneath everything.

- 
Visual Guide: A polished, first-principles PDF that explains every mechanism discussed in the video with practical examples, architecture diagrams, build order, failure modes, and a full end-to-end request flow.

- 
AI-Readable Edition: The complete guide as clean Markdown, ready to attach to ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, or another capable assistant.

- 
Implementation Prompt: A staged repository-audit prompt for adding the same primitives to Hermes, OpenClaw, a custom app, or another existing agent without copying recovered code.

- 
Build Checklist: Concrete acceptance tests for isolated transcripts, durable wakes, priority lanes, bounded meetings, private screens, scoped memory, approvals, and restart recovery.
